# Memory write-path discipline — auto-generated map

> **DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.** This file is regenerated by
> `app/memory/writers.py:generate_docs()` on every test run.
> See `MULTI_AGENT_PLATFORM.md` §3.11 for the discipline rule.

| writer | channel | destination | trigger | transformation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `record_episode` | agent_private | TCMM agent/<agent_id>/observations/<user_id>/ | every agent observation during a turn | text → tcmm.observe(source_kind=AGENT_*, extracted_by=agent:<aid>) |
| `record_heartbeat` | n/a | ledger agent_task_heartbeats (Phase 6.3) | every IC turn boundary; inbox-poller sweep uses these | (task_id, worker_id, now) → heartbeat row |
| `promote_to_semantic` | team_knowledge | TCMM team/knowledge/<team_id>/ (Critic-gated) | Critic accepts a claim destined for team_knowledge | claim → tcmm.observe with typed_claim shape + provenance |
| `log_decision` | n/a | ledger agent_tasks (status) + task_comments (SHA-chained) | state transition or review_decision | atomic write: tasks.update_status + comments.add_comment |
| `update_org_memory` | n/a | DEPRECATED post-M1-cutover 2026-05-28; use promote_lesson_to_team_knowledge | back-compat shim only; new callers must use the Phase 7 split-writer | (no-op surface; org_memory Lance table removed) |
| `enqueue_dream_input` | team_events | TCMM dream_archive (via TCMM /ingest_turn) | event crosses TCMM importance threshold | serialized event → tcmm.observe(source_kind=EVENT) |
| `record_approval` | n/a | ledger client_tool_approvals (append-only audit) | approval-gate decision (allow/deny/timeout) | approval row with TOCTOU token + immutable timestamps |
| `attach_artifact` | n/a | ledger agent_tasks.outputs[] + workspace fs (task-owned dir) | Builder produces a deliverable file | path validation + outputs[].append + fs write |
| `record_outcome_with_narrative` | team_events | ledger proposal_outcomes (numeric) + TCMM outcome_narrative observation (cross-ref via tcmm_obs_id ↔ outcome_id) | Phase 7 M2: outcome with regret/lesson narrative | ledger row first (numeric exact) → TCMM observe → write tcmm_obs_id back |
| `record_proposal_with_content` | team_events | ledger task_proposals (status index) + TCMM proposal observation (cross-ref via tcmm_obs_id ↔ proposal_id) | Phase 7 M3: proposal creation with content + rationale | ledger create_proposal → TCMM observe → write tcmm_obs_id back |
| `promote_lesson_to_team_knowledge` | team_knowledge | TCMM team/knowledge/<team_id>/ (canonical; post-M1-cutover 2026-05-28) | Phase 7 M1: Critic-validated lesson promotion | single-destination TCMM observation; legacy org_memory dual-write removed |
| `record_discussion_comment` | agent_private | TCMM agent/<author_id>/observations/ (source_kind=discussion|agent_observation) | Phase 7 M4: non-state-machine task comment | kind=comment/note → TCMM observation; state-machine kinds still go through log_decision |
